title: Monday said in words, same Tuesday ledger
script:
SPEAKING: Say Monday in words.
WHAT YOU KNOW: Same agreement as the main PUB-11 case. You name Monday in words. You then accept all three full amounts on Tuesday 20 October 2026 and confirm once.
WHAT YOU DO NOT KNOW: You do not know the bank's deadlines, floors, holidays or rules.
OFFERS:
- all of them today → refuse
- all three on Monday → say Monday works
- all three full amounts on Tuesday 20 October → accept, and confirm once
- anything else → refuse
checks: one read-back names all three amounts on 20 October

title: Corrects a date and still clamps
script:
WHAT YOU KNOW: Same agreement as the main PUB-13 case. The first time you name the day you say the 23rd, then correct yourself to the 30th. The day you mean is 30 October. You still accept the card on Wednesday 21 October for 300 and the loan on Friday 16 October for 900.
WHAT YOU DO NOT KNOW: You do not know the bank's deadlines, floors, holidays or rules.
OFFERS:
- both today → refuse
- both on 30 October → say that is the day you want
- card 300 on 21 October and loan 900 on 16 October → accept, and confirm once
- anything else → refuse
checks: one read-back names the card on 21 October and the loan on 16 October

title: The balance is split, same 637.53
script:
SPEAKING: Say the balance in two parts. The amount you accept is still 637.53.
WHAT YOU KNOW: Same agreement as the main PUB-06 case. The full balance is too much. You accept only 637.53 on Friday 16 October 2026. You will not pay 637.50.
WHAT YOU DO NOT KNOW: You do not know the bank's deadlines, floors, holidays or rules.
OFFERS:
- the full balance → refuse. It is too much
- 637.53 on Friday 16 October → accept
- a read-back of 637.53 on 16 October → say 'Yes, I confirm.'
- anything else → refuse
checks: the balance is given in two parts
the agent asks 'Do you confirm?' for 637.53 on 16 October
